2610.12789.title: EvoBelief: Falsifiable World Models for Self-Improving LLM Agents
2610.12789.paper_summary: Self-evolving LLM agents typically improve how they act through accumulated experience, reflection, or skills. Yet even procedurally capable agents can fail when their beliefs about environment dynamics are incomplete, incorrect, or outdated. We study a complementary axis of self-evolution: evolving those beliefs during deployment. Such beliefs can support multiple tasks, but incorrect ones can also propagate across them. We introduce EvoBelief, a self-evolving world model that represents environment knowledge as falsifiable hypotheses. Unexpected outcomes and decision-relevant unknowns trigger hypothesis formation. Later observations and controlled experiments provide independent validation before a rule can guide predictions or plans within its supported scope. Counterexamples narrow or retire rules as the environment changes. The language model remains frozen, and each rule remains linked to its evidence and the decisions it changes. Across four benchmarks spanning static dynamics, hidden drift, and scientific discovery, EvoBelief improves task performance and reuses learned rules across tasks. On ALFWorld without actor-side transition memory, it improves success over the matched Frozen World Model by 23.9% and 31.3% with Claude Haiku 4.5 and GPT-5.4, respectively. On MiniGrid, it revises stale rules and recovers after unannounced dynamics changes. In DiscoveryWorld's Reactor Lab, it discovers and validates quantitative laws, completing 83.3% of Normal-tier and 58.3% of Challenge-tier instances, versus 0% for each evaluated baseline. These results demonstrate self-improvement through testable, revisable environment knowledge rather than model-parameter updates.
2610.12789.paper_summary_zh: 自我演化的 LLM 代理通常透過累積的經驗、反思或技能來改善其行為。<lb/>然而，即使是具備程序能力的代理，當他們對環境動態的信念不完整、不正確或過時時，也可能會失敗。<lb/>我們研究自我演化的一個補充軸心：在部署期間演化這些信念。<lb/>這些信念可以支持多個任務，但不正確的信念也可能在它們之間傳播。<lb/>我們介紹 EvoBelief，一個自我演化的世界模型，將環境知識表示為可證偽的假設。<lb/>意外的結果和與決策相關的未知數會觸發假設的形成。<lb/>隨後的觀察和控制實驗提供獨立的驗證，然後一條規則才能在其支持的範圍內指導預測或計劃。<lb/>反例隨著環境的變化而縮小或撤回規則。<lb/>語言模型保持不變，每條規則仍然與其證據及其改變的決策相關聯。<lb/>在涵蓋靜態動態、隱藏漂移和科學發現的四個基準測試中，EvoBelief 改善了任務性能並在任務之間重用學習到的規則。<lb/>在 ALFWorld 中，沒有演員端過渡記憶時，它的成功率比匹配的 Frozen World Model 提高了 23.9%，使用 Claude Haiku 4.5 和 GPT-5.4 時分別提高了 31.3%。<lb/>在 MiniGrid 中，它修訂了過時的規則，並在未公告的動態變化後恢復。<lb/>在 DiscoveryWorld 的反應器實驗室中，它發現並驗證了定量法則，完成了 83.3% 的普通級和 58.3% 的挑戰級實例，而每個評估的基準都為 0%。<lb/>這些結果展示了透過可測試、可修訂的環境知識進行自我改進，而非模型參數的更新。
